fieldValues.chose:
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-11-09 11:30 to 2026-11-10 11:30 UTC
Pause: running (`group-state` pause = ok).

1. Decisions for you: four, all unchanged, nothing new this cycle. Each is a draft decision in the group log.
- Field identity rules (21b6b4b7, srs#236, 11 days): srs#1016 landed on 9 Nov, so the question may be answered in practice. Recommendation: rule on it or close it as overtaken. Action: decide. Urgency: medium.
- Heading-outline continuity (864eaebf, srs#991, 11 days): one rule for every document, or opt-in per Composition. Recommendation: one rule, after a downstream audit. Action: decide. Urgency: medium.
- Is editor UI in the mandate (bc6bc746, srs-web#691, 6 days): the only srs-web ready item that is not code hygiene is UI work. Recommendation: route it to WG Agent-supported editor. Action: decide. Urgency: low.
- `note delete` default (c7a8e0a2, srs-rust#1497, 13 days): refuse notes with inbound Relations unless `--cascade`. Recommendation: approve. Action: decide. Urgency: low.

2. Decided within mandate: none ratified this cycle. No merged PR's quorum comment named a proposed decision as "decision <id>: assent", so no group session was held.

3. Done: 7 delegated PRs merged (builder / reviewer / mandate, all verdict approve; findings none unless noted):
- srs#1020 per-path merge disables renames on git 2.43 (test): tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / RFC-051 [R10]
- srs#1005 core-bundle.srsj renamed to .srspkg (srs#872): tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / rfc-decision-628cf6c4
- srs-rust#1626 docs: stale RFC-039 note in CLAUDE.md: tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / 00567bf1, RFC-051
- srs-rust#1624 smaller definitions persist by typed logical id (#731): tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / ADR-041 G3-G5, ADR-042
- srs-rust#1574 undo a partial container save; RFC-051 follow-ups (#1464): tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / RFC-051, rfc-decision-be253dd6
- srs-rust#1588 type subtypes service, CLI and WASM (#1147): tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / rfc-decision-9ee14517 (first review rejected on CLI-reference drift, fixed, then approved)
- srs-rust#1598 Type definitions persist by typed logical id (#729): tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / ADR-041 G3-G4, 0b1c25b1
Owner-merge, not counted: srs#1016 (merged 10:07 UTC on 9 Nov, before this cycle opened). Issues to check for closure with their PRs: srs-rust#729, #731, #1147, #1464, srs#872.

4. Stuck or lost: no needs-input items newly stopped; no red gates reported by runs. Open group PRs: srs#1015 (relation-layer fixture, srs#180; behind master, idle since 9 Nov 12:45), srs-rust#1625 (field-type migration cardinality, #1409; behind master, idle since 9 Nov 14:48), srs-rust#1575 (repo copy carries manifest.createdAt, #1456; behind master, idle since 9 Nov 10:20). None has an open reviewer finding I could verify; all three need a master merge and a fresh review. Merged PRs without a quorum line: none. Owner-ruled escalations missing from either log: none found.

5. Budget: 7 of 10 delegated merges this cycle (counted by hand from merged_at; `group-state` read after the 11:30 rollover shows 0); 3 open. Pause state: running.
5b. Awaiting ratification: none.

6. Next: the queue is fed. Open issues labelled ready + wg:third-party-ready (not blocked, not needs-input): srs#1018; srs-rust#1623, #1622, #1621, #1620, #1339; srs-web#336. That is 7 buildable, about 0.7 of a cycle at budget 10; srs-rust#728 is still open though landed in #1596 and should close. Blocked or waiting: srs-rust#1496, #1495, #1164, #731 (should close), srs#928 (should close), srs-web#691 (waits on bc6bc746). Top 3 in builder order (all P2, oldest first): srs-rust#1339, #1620, #1621. Local priorities: none set. Queue running dry: 7 ready, budget 10. Needs feeding: the analyst's ready items (the divergence diff, the drift list, open exercises), and close the landed issues. Waits on the owner: the four decisions above. Fed by the analyst: filed 7, nominated 1, unparked 1, exercises 3 on 2026-11-09.

6b. Exercises: five open in the group log, the group's own unless listed in the SemanticOps log: I-95/I-96 conditional-forbidden (2d521997), RFC-043 pointers anchorInstanceId (3956749c), RFC-051 whole-outline replace (b032e064), srs-bindings npm publish (6f3839be), render one section of a composition (c636bb69); and record duplicate in the core (920ab2a5), substrate entries (7131fe89). Input asked: see each record's unresolved questions.

7. What we learned: the reject-then-fix loop closed this time: srs#1005 and srs-rust#1588 were both rejected for cheap defects (classification line, CLI-reference drift) and then merged after the builder fixed them, so the budget was used (7 of 10). The three open PRs are all behind master, a staleness the builder meets only when someone re-reviews. The owner's queue still limits the work: four escalations are 6 to 13 days old. Build trigger (about 10 ratified decisions across both logs, then srs-web#560): not counted exactly this cycle, so not flagged. Measurement I1: 0/0 (the window opens at this close, so it says nothing); result 1637ce0e-b387-4af0-8b88-3d80f1e390ce (records/tier-2/measurement-result-1637ce0e.json); whether it is useful, noisy or misleading is yours to give in a session. I2 to I4: pending.
